title: Dlatego że · podczas gdy
title_en: Because, that's why, while — and the formal twins
note: C1-SPINE Block 9 unit 2; B2-SPINE inbox item 23, second half. FIVE NEW STRINGS AND ZERO NEW MORPHOLOGY, all of one class - invariable joiners on clauses the learner can already build, c1_concessive's shape one node earlier. It is a bigger word-count than that unit but a SMALLER load, because two of the five cost nothing at all: jezeli and gdy are the formal twins of jesli and kiedy, which b2_jesli fenced by name, and they are one line each rather than a fact. THE HEADLINE IS THE ze FLIP, and it is the reason dlatego and dlatego ze belong in one unit rather than two: the same word points BACKWARD to a reason with ze on it (Ide do domu, dlatego ze jestem zmeczony) and FORWARD to a result without it (Jestem zmeczony, dlatego ide do domu). Slide 1 is a 2x2 against the owned pair bo / wiec, which point the same two ways. PAYS b2_conjunctions' LOGGED SCOPE CUT IN FULL: that pack dropped dlatego BECAUSE its everyday partner dlatego ze was on the C1 list, and refused to ship 'a half-taught pair pointing at a fenced construction'. Both halves land here together, which is the whole reason the cut was made. BARE podczas IS FENCED, exactly as bare mimo was one node earlier: on its own it is a PREPOSITION governing the Genitive (podczas obiadu), a new case governor needing its own case-map.json row. podczas gdy is taught as one indivisible joiner and the slide says the two words are never separated. NO case-map row is owed by this unit - a conjunction governs nothing. THE RESUMPTIVE to IS PAID, CHEAPLY AND WITHOUT BEING DRILLED. b2_jesli held it to C1 and it costs zero new lemmas (to is glue, taught since A1). Slide 3 shows Jesli masz czas, to zrobie obiad, states that to adds nothing and may always be left out, and every Uzycie item whose conditional clause comes first carries the to variant in accepts. It is never demanded. The reversed clause order b2_jesli also held is carried on the same slide, where it is reinforcement rather than new load - c1_concessive established it one node back for chociaz. SYNONYMS ARE NEVER PITTED AGAINST EACH OTHER, the rule c1_concessive settled: no Kontrola item offers jesli beside jezeli or kiedy beside gdy, and no item offers dlatego where wiec would also be right or bo where dlatego ze would. Every Uzycie item whose prompt admits an owned synonym (bo for dlatego ze, wiec for dlatego, Kiedy for Gdy, Jesli for Jezeli) carries that variant in accepts - marking correct Polish wrong is the false-wrong James smoke-flagged on 2026-08-07. Pisanie items 1-5 are the five bare joiners with disambiguating English glosses, which is b2_conjunctions' own genre and the only shape in which the new form can be demanded without a synonym competing for the slot; items 6-12 blank the load-bearing form with the joiner visible, logged per the repair-queue fallback clause. CAUGHT IN SELF-REVIEW: the podczas gdy slide carried the body_pl line "w tym samym czasie", whose tym/samym/czasie are all UNTAUGHT - the AGENTS convention admits metalanguage on that line, not new lexis, which is the exact defect b2_which_case had to fix in czasem/bez. Replaced with a taught example sentence. gotowala (3sg feminine past of gotowac) is NOT in the pool - only gotowalam/gotowalem and the perfective ugotowala are - so every podczas gdy sentence was rebuilt on pracowala / czytal / czytala, which are all taught. gazete was refused again (NEW; only the plural gazety is taught) and pojdziemy likewise (the -my person of pojsc is absent from the pool).

intro.title: Dlatego, and what the że does to it
intro.body:
You already have two words for tying a cause to its effect, and they point in opposite directions. bo points backwards, at the reason. więc points forwards, at the result.

Today's word does both jobs — and what decides which one is a single syllable on the end of it.

dlatego że points backwards, at the reason. It is the fuller, heavier way of saying bo, and it is the one you will more often meet in writing.

dlatego on its own points forwards, at the result: that is why.

So the że is not decoration. Take it off and the sentence reverses.

rows: Idę do domu, bo jestem zmęczony.
back, to the reason
I'm going home because I'm tired.
Idę do domu, dlatego że jestem zmęczony.
back, to the reason — fuller
I'm going home because I'm tired.
Jestem zmęczony, więc idę do domu.
forward, to the result
I'm tired, so I'm going home.
Jestem zmęczony, dlatego idę do domu.
forward, to the result
I'm tired, that's why I'm going home.

intro.title: Podczas gdy — two things at once
intro.title_pl: Mama pracowała, podczas gdy tata czytał książkę.
intro.body:
podczas gdy joins two clauses and says the two things overlapped: while one was going on, so was the other. Often it also sets them against each other, the way English while does in he sat while I worked.

It is two words and they are never separated. The comma goes in front of the whole thing.

Compare it with a, which you have had since B2. a puts two different things side by side and makes no claim at all about when they happened. podczas gdy claims they were happening together.
intro.body_pl: Mama pracowała, podczas gdy tata czytał.

Dzieci były w parku, podczas gdy pracowałem.

intro.title: Jeżeli and gdy — the same words, dressed for writing
intro.title_pl: Jeżeli masz czas… · Gdy pada deszcz…
intro.body:
Two of today's words are not new ideas at all. They are longer, more formal versions of words you already own, and they change nothing else in the sentence.

jeśli → jeżeli. kiedy → gdy.

Use either. You will meet the formal one in writing and in careful speech, and now you will recognise it.

Two things worth knowing about where these clauses sit. First, the clause can come first or second — the same freedom chociaż had, and the comma still goes at the join. Second, when the condition comes first, Polish very often plants to at the head of the second half: Jeśli masz czas, to zrobię obiad. It adds nothing to the meaning and it can always be left out.

rows: jeśli
jeżeli
Jeżeli masz czas, zrobię obiad.
kiedy
gdy
Gdy pada deszcz, jestem w domu.

quiz.prompt: Idę do domu, ___ jestem zmęczony. (because — the fuller two-word form)
quiz.explain: Without the że the same word points the other way: dlatego would make the tiredness the result of going home rather than the reason for it.

quiz.prompt: Jestem zmęczony, ___ idę do domu. (that's why)
quiz.explain: Here the second half is the result, so the word stands bare. Adding że would claim that going home is what made me tired.

quiz.prompt: Mama pracowała, ___ tata czytał książkę. (while — at the same time)
quiz.explain: Neither half caused the other. They simply ran at the same time, which is the one thing podczas gdy claims.

quiz.prompt: ___ masz czas, zrobię obiad. (if — the formal one)
quiz.explain: The formal twin of jeśli. Nothing else in the sentence changes — the condition still takes an ordinary present, and the result still takes a perfective future.

quiz.prompt: ___ pada deszcz, jestem w domu. (when — the formal one)
quiz.explain: The formal twin of kiedy. None of the other three can stand at the front of a sentence in this job.

quiz.prompt: Nie kupiłem chleba, ___ sklep był zamknięty. (because)
quiz.explain: The shut shop is the reason, so the word points backwards and takes its że.

quiz.prompt: Sklep jest zamknięty, ___ idę do centrum. (that's why)
quiz.explain: Going to the centre is the result of the shop being shut. bo and dlatego że would both reverse it.

quiz.prompt: Tata czyta książkę, ___ mama pracuje. (while — at the same time)
quiz.explain: i would simply add the second fact on. podczas gdy says the two are running together.

quiz.prompt: Nie idę do parku, ___ pada deszcz. (because — the everyday one)
quiz.explain: bo is still the word you reach for in speech. dlatego że would be right here too — dlatego on its own would not.
Cooking is the result of the hunger. dlatego że and bo both point the wrong way.

quiz.prompt: ___ tata był w pracy, mama czytała książkę. (while — at the same time)
quiz.explain: The two-word joiner can open the sentence, and the comma sits after the whole first clause.

quiz.prompt: ___ pogoda będzie ładna, będę w parku. (if — the formal one)
quiz.explain: A real condition about the future. The verb pattern is b2's unchanged: będzie in the condition, będę in the result.
